div.head: Annex A
div.p: Noting with grave concern that, in rejecting the General Assembly Resolution of December 3, 1952, the Chinese People’s Government of the People’s Republic of China and the North Korean authorities have prevented the conclusion of an armistice in Korea;

Affirms that it continues to be the policy of the United Nations to bring about a cessation of hostilities in Korea in accordance with United Nations principles and to achieve United Nations objectives in Korea by peaceful means;

Appeals to all members, pending the agreement of the Chinese People’s Government of the People’s Republic of China and the North Korean authorities to an honorable armistice consistent with United Nations principles, to continue and intensify their efforts in support of the United Nations action in Korea and in particular to furnish assistance, including additional troops, to the United Nations Command, pursuant to the Security Council Resolutions of June 25 and 27, 1950 and General Assembly Resolution 376 (V), of October 7, 1950.
